about_the_game:
The first live tour of the official FFXIV band is now available as a live album!

As the official band of the hit MMORPG, FINAL FANTASY XIV, THE PRIMALS have been actively performing both in Japan and abroad.

In May 2018, they released their major debut album THE PRIMALS.

Following the release, they embarked on a five-city live tour across four cities in Japan and Seoul, South Korea delivering electrifying performances at every stop.

From this tour, the June 3, 2018 show in Osaka is now available as a live album!

*The tracklist differs from the Blu-ray version.

*This is an audio-only album and does not include video content.
